description.text: Immersive Technology for the American Workforce Act of 2025

latestAction.text: Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions. Hearings held.

bill.title: Immersive Technology for the American Workforce Act of 2025

aiDescription.summary: The Act funds DOL competitive grants to community colleges, career and technical education centers, and industry partnerships to build immersive technology career pathways using VR/AR/MR for workforce training. Grants run up to five years, prioritize employer-aligned and accessible programs, and require reporting, independent evaluation, and publication of best practices.

impact.summary: The bill tells the Secretary of Labor to fund community colleges, area CTE schools, Tribal colleges, and industry partnerships to build immersive (VR/AR/XR/MR) career-pathway training. Grants prioritize employer-aligned programs serving veterans and people with disabilities, last up to five years, and require DOL reporting.
